title: OWASP Top 10:2025
prompt: Which risk is A01 in the OWASP Top 10:2025?
explanation: OWASP Top 10:2025 keeps Broken Access Control at A01. A02 is Security Misconfiguration and A03 is Software Supply Chain Failures. Injection is A05 in this edition.

misconceptions.explanation: OWASP categories and numbers can change by edition; identify the 2025 list before recalling older positions.
misconceptions.retry: State A01 and one nearby category from the same edition.

retryPrompt: State the key distinction in your own words, then retry once.
